items.name: 文件互传
items.evidenceRequired: Real file bytes on two authorized Linux nodes, source/target permissions, traversal/symlink, resume/checksum, conflict/disconnect/partial results

items.name: 服务组
items.evidenceRequired: Independent servicegroup identity, permissions and frozen members; changes cannot expand old tasks

items.name: 批量任务
items.evidenceRequired: Real task/Agent normal, batch/canary, failure gate, approval invalidation, TTL and no duplicate side effects on unknown results

items.name: Nginx网关
items.evidenceRequired: POC-05; actual install and safe adoption, old site intact, port/config/health failure and manual admission

items.name: DNS管理
items.evidenceRequired: Authorized provider integration, multiple accounts/Zones, permission/expired credentials and secret non-disclosure

items.name: 公网证书与内部TLS
items.evidenceRequired: ACME and internal trust separately verified; distinct node identities, renew/rotate/revoke, wrong CA and expired/revoked denial

items.name: 监控告警与QQ/SMTP
items.evidenceRequired: Authorized delivery sandbox, deduplication/fallback, provider refusal and retry storm; no fake delivered status

items.name: AI会话资源授权
items.evidenceRequired: POC-06; zero initial resources, group snapshot, revoked scope/old revision, indirect plugin/batch permission denial

items.name: AI三级审批
items.evidenceRequired: POC-06; all modes, expiry/replay, mandatory human admin approval for AI arbitrary root shell even full access

items.name: 插件平台
items.evidenceRequired: POC-01/02; package source/signature, install/disable/hot update/uninstall, runtime isolation/limits, no residual executable API

items.name: 更新中心
items.evidenceRequired: Actual signed/hash-verified update and health/failure injection; restart preserves jobs, irreversible migrations not called rollback

items.name: 工作流、用户权限与审计
items.evidenceRequired: Workflow uses same authorization/tasks/approval, read-only cannot modify, persistent audit with no secrets

items.name: 服务发布向导
items.evidenceRequired: Servicegroup/gateway/DNS/certificate staged integration, partial gateway failure, denied Zone, real DNS propagation limitations

items.name: 服务可用性监控
items.evidenceRequired: Real HTTP/TCP/TLS probes plus SSRF/denied destination, failure/recovery and maintenance history, distinguish lost probe from outage

items.name: 安全批量执行
items.evidenceRequired: Frozen targets, accurate dry-run levels, circuit thresholds/TTL/phase checks; cancel not rollback and no unauthorized new members

items.name: 节点恢复与主控灾备
items.evidenceRequired: POC-08; isolated offline recovery with actual trust material, old controller isolation, revocations/expired tasks never resurrect

items.name: 安全凭据
items.evidenceRequired: Write-only secret metadata, rotation/revoke/expiry, GET/log/audit/AI no secret or offline root key disclosure

items.name: 流量配额与到期提醒
items.evidenceRequired: Per-node cycles/time boundaries, estimates distinguished from billing, no missing-as-zero, deduped thresholds and no automatic disconnect
